public_payload.normalized_proposition: As of June 2026, OpenAI is leaning toward delaying its IPO until 2027.

statement.excerpt: OpenAI is leaning towards delaying its IPO until next year:
statement.document_title: The month Generative AI lost its mojo

our_interpretation: This describes OpenAI's preference in late June 2026, not a prediction that an IPO will actually occur in 2027.
The surrounding reference to news from the last few days sets the observation period to June 19–26, 2026.
Leaning means favoring postponement while retaining the option to change course.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous reporting based on people involved in the deliberations, company statements, or planning records establishes that OpenAI favored postponing its IPO to 2027.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable evidence about the same deliberations establishes that OpenAI favored a 2026 listing and that the reported preference for postponement was incorrect.
